records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Dynamics* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Two Wrenfield outreaches (email:43655bb7, email:6cab7ea9) got no reply, and no tickets filed, so no evidence of engagement. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-start, but silence plus a total cold start makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my note last week — I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy stretch. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project with a few tasks is usually enough to see whether it fits. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
